about_the_game:
This is your Lucky Break🍀! You've matched with three beautiful women and now it's time to go on dates with them and find the one... or maybe not. The choice is yours.

Plot/Characters

As a player, you take the role of a guy living in Queens and having no luck on dating apps. But then one day, your phone lights up. You get three matches in one day. Each woman is striking in her own way, and each one of them pulls you deeper into something you never saw coming.

Who will you end up with?

Ellie - The quiet barista who sketches the world in coffee stains and daydreams. Behind her shy exterior lies a poetic heart and creative spirit, waiting for someone who appreciates her unique point of view.

Alexandra - The sharp-minded analyst from a prestigious investment bank who’s used to the world of numbers and masks. However, with the right choice, you just might hit the bullseye.

Katerina - The radiant hotel manager who greets the world with laughter. She flirts easily, loves recklessly, and hides a desire to gain your attention completely.

Languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Russian,

Your Choices Shape Everything

Meaningful Decisions: Every word you say, every move you make, changes the story

Dynamic Storytelling: Conversations twist in unexpected ways.

Replayable Romance: Revisit your choices, discover new scenes, and explore every possible ending.

Role Playing Elements

Choose your background — Construction Worker (Money💵), Personal Trainer (Strength💪), or Sales Associate (Charisma😎) — and manage your stats to unlock unique dialogue options. Between dates, decide: work extra shifts for cash, or invest in self-improvement? Your stats directly influence how each woman responds to you.

Balance strategy and sacrifice to become the man they can't resist.

Key Features

Cinematic FMV Experience: High-quality video scenes bring each character to life.

First-Person Romance Simulation: See every moment through the protagonist’s eyes. Feel every choice and every decision as if it were your own.

Compelling Characters: Each woman is richly drawn, full of personality, mystery, and emotion you’ll want to explore.

Mature Content: Each glance, each kiss, and each steamy possibility is captured in cinematic detail.

Choice-Driven Narrative: Each chosen option deepens — or destroys — the connections you build with each of these unique female characters.

Multiple Endings: From heartbreak to happily ever after. What you go for decides who stays, who leaves, and how your story ends.

Will you play it safe or take risks? Be yourself or become who you think they want? In Lucky Break, every choice has a price, and every woman has her secret.

About Us

We’re a small indie team passionate about crafting immersive, choice-driven stories. We make games that let you live your choices, and fall for our unforgettable characters.
